title: Deactivating a rep clears their customer fields and removes Part Sales
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create three active staff members for this test at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A, sales rep B and sales rep C.
  • Create customer A for this test, with "Sales Representative - Service Labor" set to sales rep A, "Sales Representative - Service Parts" set to sales rep B and "Sales Representative - Part Sales" set to sales rep C.
  • Create customer B for this test, whose one Sales Representative is sales rep C.
  • Open Settings > Staff in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Start deactivating sales rep C's account and read the Deactivate window.
  2. Confirm the deactivation.
  3. Open customer A's page.
  4. Open customer B's page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Deactivate window reads "They will be removed as sales representative from 2 customers." (customer A once, customer B once).
  • The old line "Their customer assignments will stay where they are." is not shown.

Step 2:

  • Sales rep C is deactivated.

Step 3:

  • Customer A shows Service Labor sales rep A and Service Parts sales rep B.
  • The Part Sales field is gone, so new part sales follow Service Parts.

Step 4:

  • Customer B shows "Sales Representative" reading "Unassigned".

The Sales By Representative spec, version 28 (12 Oct 2026, Story 13), still keeps a deactivated person on their customers. Chris Ward ruled on 19 Oct 2026 for the PRD (answers 12 and 13, quoted below); this case follows PRD version 10, which removes them.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R20: “Deactivating a staff member's account removes them from every customer field they hold. The customer's other fields keep their people. A Part Sales field where they were picked is removed, so new part sales follow again (S4-R26). Reactivating the account does not put them back.”
  • S4-R21: “The Deactivate window, shown before deactivating a sales representative's account, counts every customer where they are in the first field, Service Parts or Part Sales, counting each customer once, and reads "They will be removed as sales representative from {n} customer{s}.", with "customer" when {n} is 1 and "customers" otherwise, in place of today's "Their customer assignments will stay where they are." The "Turn Off Sales Representative" warning, shown when the Sales Representative switch is turned off, does not change and shows no count (S4-N2).”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 12: “12. (a) as the feature spec: removed from every customer field they hold, not put back on reactivation. New warning line: "They will be removed as sales representative from {n} customers."”
  • Chris Ward's answer 13: “13. (a) Only the Deactivate window; the Turn Off Sales Representative warning stays as it is.”
